Run the unit suite with:

```
make test-fast
```

This skips the Postgres tests. To run everything, start the database first and then run the full target:

```
docker compose up db
make test
```

The `Makefile` defines both targets (`test-fast` and `test`). I took the Postgres detail from a stored project note and did not check it against the recipes.
